text: Heads-up from b7z9.3.3 (released, sequence-blocked on you): the shared reject vector cannot land before your code because (a) lichen-rpl is_generalized_target_body (message.rs:436) does not check the Target flags octet, so Rust accepts today and both Rust vector suites assert current behavior; (b) the python test oracle _dao_structure (test_vectors.py:2356) also skips the flags byte and needs a one-line extension; (c) your reject should pin to the existing malformed_dao reason vocabulary, decision_stage=structural, envelope_valid=false (dao_origin.py:296-298 already implements the structural check). Full landing recipe (generator snippet + consumer updates + regen command) is in the b7z9.3.3 comment — fold the vector into your 3.1 commit and close 3.3 on that merge, or re-claim 3.3 after your code lands.
